major.name: Major Arcana
major.description: The 22 numbered trump cards, from The Fool (0) to The World (XXI). They describe major life themes, turning points and lessons.

minor.name: Minor Arcana
minor.description: The 56 suited cards, fourteen in each of four suits. They describe everyday situations, people and events.

wands.name: Wands
wands.description: The suit of fire: energy, ambition, creativity and action.

cups.name: Cups
cups.description: The suit of water: emotions, relationships, intuition and love.

swords.name: Swords
swords.description: The suit of air: thought, truth, communication and conflict.

pentacles.name: Pentacles
pentacles.description: The suit of earth: work, money, health, home and practical matters.

past-present-future.name: Past, Present, Future
past-present-future.description: A three-card spread that shows where a situation came from, where it stands now and where it is likely heading.

past.label: Past
past.description: Influences and events that led to the current situation.

present.label: Present
present.description: The situation as it stands now, including the energy around you.

future.label: Future
future.description: The likely direction if things continue on their current course.
